name: Turok 7 The prison of the Oblivion
author: Jojo2010
description:
Welcome to the first chapter of my little story! 

---------------------STORY----------------------------
When Turok woke up, he was already in the prison of oblivion.
There were everywhere robots.
This prison was created only for you, so you have to escape it and
collect all the microchips to destroy the Oblivion,
or the Oblivion will destroy the whole universe.
You are the only one who can stop the destruction...
